name: DICLOFENAC SODIUM / VITAMINS B1 / B6 / B12 30 TABLETS
description: Diclofenac is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) with analgesic (pain reliever) and antipyretic (fever reducer) properties. Its mechanism of action is by inhibiting cyclooxygenase, an enzyme that produces prostaglandins, which cause inflammation and pain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
